edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
_to parameter flows into the transferFrom call made by transfer.
_value parameter flows into the transferFrom call made by transfer.
msg.sender determines whether the allowance branch is taken and whose allowance is debited.
_from address selects the balance and allowance entries mutated by transferFrom.
_to address selects the balance entry credited by transferFrom.
_value amount is subtracted from allowance and balanceOf inside transferFrom.
balanceOf mapping is read and written by transferFrom.
allowance mapping is read and written by transferFrom.
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic in Solidity 0.5.
The ensure modifier wraps and gates the transferFrom body.
The ensure modifier invokes pairFor to derive the allowed Uniswap pair address.
ensure._from is compared against owner and pair addresses in the modifier.
ensure._to is compared against owner and pair addresses in the modifier.
_spender parameter is used as the allowance key in approve.
_value parameter is stored as the allowance amount in approve.
msg.sender is the owner key under which the allowance is granted in approve.
allowance mapping is written by approve.
msg.sender must match one of the owner addresses before the delegatecall is executed.
owner is compared with msg.sender in the delegate access-control require.
Target address a is the callee of the delegatecall inside delegate.
Calldata b is forwarded to the delegatecall inside delegate.
delegate executes the unsafe a.delegatecall(b) operation.
msg.sender must match an owner address and is also the debited account in batchSend.
owner is compared with msg.sender in the batchSend access-control require.
_tos array drives the loop and recipient balances in batchSend.
_value amount is multiplied and credited per recipient in batchSend.
Local total is used for the balanceOf check and debit in batchSend.
Loop index i controls iteration over _tos in batchSend.
balanceOf mapping is read and written by batchSend.
batchSend performs unchecked multiplication and subtraction without SafeMath.
factory parameter is packed into the pair address computation.
tokenA parameter is ordered and hashed in pairFor.
tokenB parameter is ordered and hashed in pairFor.
_name parameter is stored into the name state variable.
_symbol parameter is stored into the symbol state variable.
_supply parameter is stored into totalSupply.
msg.sender becomes owner and receives the entire initial supply in the constructor.
The constructor writes balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
The constructor writes totalSupply = _supply.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
The constructor sets an unlimited allowance for the Uniswap router.
UNI constant is used as the spender key in the constructor allowance initialization.
